label: Starship crew
blurb: A battered freighter working the edge of settled space: cheap jobs, corporate patrols, derelicts worth salvaging and things in the dark between stars.
tone: Lived-in science fiction, tense but warm; the crew bicker like family.
opening: Open the campaign: the crew's ship docks at a run-down station with an empty fuel tank and an offer of work that pays too well.
